text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Faster and stronger than anyone! Shining 
in a fleeting instant, leaving an 
impression that lingers for ages—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"That is the supreme vintage I strive for! 
Never forget that, my guide of destiny."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
